svg.title: One agent decision loop
svg.desc: Frozen agent identity, visible game facts, personally heard dialogue, private memory, and current stakes form a bounded context. The model returns a typed proposal. Deterministic phase validation accepts, repairs, rejects, or falls back. Accepted choices become canonical facts while every call can produce separate evidence for later reflection.
